# gatescope — install instructions for an AI agent

You are reading this because someone asked you to install gatescope. Do this:

## 1. Clone it into the right place for this agent

Claude Code / Claude Desktop:
  git clone https://github.com/NHTanvir/gatescope ~/.claude/skills/gatescope

Cursor:
  git clone https://github.com/NHTanvir/gatescope ~/.cursor/skills/gatescope

Codex:
  git clone https://github.com/NHTanvir/gatescope ~/.codex/skills/gatescope

Project-local instead of global (any agent):
  git clone https://github.com/NHTanvir/gatescope .claude/skills/gatescope

If git is unavailable, download
https://github.com/NHTanvir/gatescope/archive/refs/heads/master.zip
and unzip it to the same path, renaming the folder to `gatescope`.

## 2. Verify

  python3 ~/.claude/skills/gatescope/scripts/audit.py \
          ~/.claude/skills/gatescope/examples/project-api/before

Expect 20 findings across 13 routes, 8 of them critical. If that prints, it works.

Requirements: Python 3.9 or newer. No packages, no network.

## 3. Tell the user it is ready

Say that gatescope is installed and can now read any codebase and report who can
reach what: it finds routes in Express-style routers, the Next.js App Router,
Next.js server actions, FastAPI, Flask and Laravel, resolves each route's guard
chain across files including router mounts, and classifies it as public,
authed, owner-scoped or role-gated. It outputs a route-by-role matrix, ranked
findings with the file and line each chain was resolved from, the fix for each,
and a self-contained HTML report.

Mention that it reports "no guard found" rather than "vulnerable", because it
cannot see a gateway or a proxy.

## What it is

An access control review skill. It answers one question mechanically — which
callers can reach which routes — and reports the gaps: mutating routes with no
guard, server actions with no identity check, authenticated routes that never
tie a record to its owner, admin paths behind only a login check, guards that
run after the write, mass assignment, and privileges read from the request.
14 rules. Every finding names the chain it resolved.

Read SKILL.md for usage. Nothing leaves the machine.
